caption: “The Pink Moccasin-Flower. (Cypripedium acaule.),” from Grace Greylock Niles, Bog-Trotting for Orchids (New York: The Knickerbocker Press, 1904), colored frontispiece.
alt: A color photograph of pink lady’s slippers growing in a shady wood: several tall stems, each with a single pink, pouch-shaped flower, above broad, ribbed leaves.
bibliography: Niles, Grace Greylock. "The Pink Moccasin-Flower (Cypripedium acaule)." Frontispiece, Bog-Trotting for Orchids, Knickerbocker Press, 1904.
